product_summary: No website, catalogue or product page attributable to a firm named 'J J Chemicals' with proprietor 'Jagdishbhai Vallabhbhai Senjaliya' could be located. The only Gujarat entity surfaced under a similar name is 'New JJ Chemicals' (Narolgam, Ahmedabad, GST 24BJQPK1650J1Z2, proprietor Mr. Jaymin Kanziya, est. 2013), which sells household cleaning chemicals under the 'Urxy' brand: toilet cleaner 500 ml / 1 L / 5 L, glass cleaner 5 L, laundry liquid detergent, 2-in-1 liquid detergent, mosquito repellent spray, white phenyl, floor cleaners (source: https://www.exportersindia.com/new-j-j-chemicals/). This is a different proprietor and a different GST PAN prefix (BJQPK vs. the claimed Senjaliya), so it cannot be attributed to the company in this batch. No product list for the claimed entity is public.
comment: HS 291815 = 'Salts and esters of citric acid' (citrates, e.g. trisodium citrate, citric acid esters) — a fine/specialty organic chemical line. Nothing in the public record corroborates that this company handles citrates or any citric-acid derivatives: no website, no catalogue, no product page, no customs line found. The declared code is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' and match_status is cannot_verify, not wrong — there is simply no product evidence either way. Two flags for the desk: (1) the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' does not fit HS 291815 at all — citric acid salts are industrial/food-additive chemicals, not FMCG goods; if the company is in fact a household-cleaning producer (as the similarly named Ahmedabad firm is), the correct codes would be 3402.20 (surface-active preparations / cleaning preparations), 3402.90, 3808.94 (disinfectants) or 3808.91 (insecticides — mosquito repellent spray), and the industry label is misclassified. (2) The only matching-name firm found is a small local manufacturer/trader of cleaning liquids, i.e. a trader/manufacturer-trader profile, not a citric-acid chemical supplier. Per project rules the company is NOT rejected on HS grounds: it stays in the base with the declared code flagged as unverified and the actual code to be corrected once the real product line is confirmed. Recommended next step: obtain the firm's own invoice/product list or GST-registered trade name to disambiguate from 'New JJ Chemicals' before fixing the HS code. No revenue, export volume, CIN, PAN or shipment data was researched or asserted here (out of scope for this role); all such fields are null.
